summary: The editor decided R8 in session: one repository per language, the same structure, the vectors on the site. Written and shipped: the policy v0 standard with 28 vectors generated from the oracle (tools/gen_vectors.py), the registry, the brief on the repositories, R21 for the editor to create them (the app cannot: 403). JavaScript and Go implementations of policy hash and check pass every vector and are staged on the CLI's orphan branches claude/js-reference and claude/go-reference; Rust carries the structure only. pbp@sharness's one-page PBP (v0.5.17) is the latest published; nothing newer on any branch.
